David mourned for Saul and Jonathan. How does David's grief show his heart?
David sang a lament: "How the mighty have fallen!" How can you honour those who have died?
David asked the Lord before going up. How do you seek God in new seasons?
David blessed the men of Jabesh-gilead for their kindness. How can you thank those who show kindness?
Abner asked, "Shall the sword devour forever?" How can conflict be stopped?
David grew stronger and stronger. How does God grow his work over time?
Abner worked to bring Israel to David. How does God bring people together?
David mourned Abner and refused to approve of murder. What does integrity in grief look like?
David refused to reward violence done in his name. What does this show about David's character?
David said the Lord "has redeemed my life out of every adversity." How has God redeemed you?
All Israel came to David at Hebron. How does God fulfil his promises in his time?
"David became greater and greater, for the Lord, the God of hosts, was with him." What makes someone truly great?
David asked God before each battle. Why ask God even after past victories?
Uzzah touched the ark and died. What does this teach about God's holiness?
David danced before the Lord with all his might. How do you express joy in worship?
Michal despised David's worship. Why might others look down on wholehearted worship?
David wanted to build God a house, but God had other plans. How do you respond when God redirects your plans?
God promised to build David a house and an everlasting kingdom. How does this point to Jesus?
David asked, "Who am I, O Lord God?" How does God's grace humble you?
The Lord gave victory to David wherever he went. How has God helped you?
David administered justice and equity to all his people. How can you act justly in your sphere?
David asked, "Is there still anyone left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness?" Who could you show kindness to?
Mephibosheth ate at the king's table like one of the king's sons. How does this picture God's grace to you?
David's kindness was misunderstood. How do you respond when kindness is rejected?
Joab said, "Be of good courage... and may the Lord do what seems good to him." How can you trust God with the outcome?
David stayed home when kings go to war, and he sinned. How does idleness open the door to temptation?
Uriah was more faithful than David. What does Uriah's integrity show?
"The thing that David had done displeased the Lord." What does this show about God seeing everything?
Nathan's story made David angry at someone else's sin. Why is it easier to see others' sin?
Nathan said, "You are the man!" and David said, "I have sinned against the Lord." What does true confession look like?
The Lord put away David's sin, though consequences remained. How do forgiveness and consequences work together?
David worshipped after his child died. How can you worship in grief?
Amnon's lust led to terrible harm. How does God's heart respond to such wrong?
David was very angry but did nothing. What happens when wrongs are not dealt with?
Absalom took revenge. How does unresolved anger grow?
The woman of Tekoa said God devises means so the banished one is not cast out. How does God bring people back?
"We must all die... but God... devises means so that the banished one will not remain an outcast." How does this point to the gospel?
David kissed Absalom but the relationship was not healed. What does true reconciliation need?
Absalom stole the hearts of the people. How can flattery mislead?
Ittai said, "Wherever my lord the king shall be, there also will your servant be." What does loyalty to Jesus look like?
David said, "If I find favour in the eyes of the Lord, he will bring me back." How can you trust God in uncertainty?
David let Shimei curse him, saying, "It may be that the Lord will look on the wrong done to me." How do you respond to insults?
Ahithophel's counsel was like the word of God, but it was evil. How can you discern wise counsel?
The Lord defeated Ahithophel's good counsel. What does this show about God's control?
Friends brought David food in the wilderness. How can you care for someone in need?
David asked his commanders to deal gently with Absalom. What does this show about a father's love?
David's first question was about Absalom's welfare. How does this show love that persists?
David cried, "O Absalom, my son, my son! Would I had died instead of you." How does this echo God's love for us?
Joab told David his grief was discouraging his people. How do we balance grief and responsibility?
David forgave Shimei. What does mercy look like when you have power?
Barzillai served David faithfully in old age. How can you be faithful in later years?
Sheba called Israel to leave David. How can people be led away by a single voice?
A wise woman saved her city. How can wisdom bring peace?
David sought the face of the Lord about the famine. How do you seek God in hardship?
David's men defeated giants. How does God use many people in his work?
"The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer." Which picture of God speaks to you?
David called to the Lord in distress and God heard. When has God rescued you?
"With my God I can leap over a wall." How does God give you strength?
"The Lord lives, and blessed be my rock." How can you praise God today?
David says a ruler who rules justly is like morning light. How can you bring light where you lead?
David poured out the water his men risked their lives for. What does this show about honouring sacrifice?
David's heart struck him after he counted the people. What do you rely on instead of God?
David said, "Let us fall into the hand of the Lord, for his mercy is great." How does this show trust in God's mercy?
David said, "I will not offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God that cost me nothing." What does costly worship look like?
